THE PROJECT

Small store. Real practice.

GreenKart is a grocery shopping demo for functional, regression, UI and end-to-end automation testing.

Explore product search, category filters, cart quantities, pricing, promo validation and checkout with country selection. Orders are simulated and no payment or personal information is collected.

Promo code: FRESH10 for 10% off.

Designed for Playwright with JavaScript and Page Object Model. Stable data-testid attributes support reusable tests.
